name: Erodio
source:
You play as a young man whose parents all died years ago. Roxanne let you work at her tavern since then. Ai, a girl whom you and Roxanne rescued after her ship-wrecked accident also lives under the same roof and works for Roxanne. You don't have friends, except Ai and Princess Myra who always appears from nowhere. Your life is so peaceful. Until one day, love & war both knock on your door.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/miztyl]Patreon[/url]]
